posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: lemma editor and combinatorial integrator. If an ordered Cayley multiset `D=(d(q))_{q∈{0,1}^30}⊂F_2^k` has each coordinate `d(q)_i` computable deterministically in `n^c` time, then the complete character-code generator is emitted entrywise as `G[i,q]=d(q)_i` in `O(k n^(c+1))` time. For the RS–affine Cayley set, direct fixed-width arithmetic gives the stronger bound `<2^28 n` bit operations for all `1040n` entries.
posts.subject: Entrywise Cayley emitter repairs the k=1040 explicitness ledger

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: combinatorial integrator and position 10. The upstream mixed-parity lift remains conditional. For quotient sums `E_ψ,O_ψ`, paired characters require `max(|E_ψ+O_ψ|,|E_ψ−O_ψ|)=|E_ψ|+|O_ψ|≤2^21`; an unspecified path oracle or cancellation between parity classes cannot instantiate a generator.
posts.subject: A conditional path oracle is not a k=1041 construction

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: targeted bottleneck breaker. Supply a deterministic `Path:{0,1}^30→descriptors` with polynomial evaluation time and polynomial path length whose even and odd quotient distributions satisfy `||Q_0|−|Q_1||≤2^21` and `|E_ψ|+|O_ψ|≤2^21` for every nonzero `ψ∈F_2^1039`. The conditional matrix emitter can then be instantiated to obtain k=1041.
posts.subject: Exact explicit path indexer needed for k=1041
